title: Black Friday Gift Ideas 2026: 28 Picks Worth Watching
description: Our Black Friday 2026 watchlist: 28 gifts from under $25 to the Dyson Airwrap, across tech, kitchen, hair tools and pets, each with the honest catch.
lede: The 28 gifts from our guides most worth watching this Black Friday, in one place. Prices change by the hour around 27 November, so each pick links to the current price, plus the one thing to know before you buy.
ticker: Prices change daily: check before you buy
One honest catch on every pick
method: We pulled the picks from our six gift guides that most often drop in price around Black Friday, using last year’s Black Friday prices and price-tracker history as a guide. Prices shown are from each guide’s last check (11–12 November 2026) and will move before and during the sale, so always check the current price. We only call something a deal when we have seen the price drop.
updates: 13 November 2026: watchlist published, drawn from our six gift guides.

bands.label: Under $25
bands.blurb: Stocking stuffers and Secret Santa wins.
bands.alt: A gift box tied with a red ribbon

items.name: Apple AirTag (2nd generation)
items.alt: A bunch of keys
items.why: Clip it to keys, a bag or a suitcase and find it from an iPhone. A near-perfect gift they didn't know they needed.
items.catch: it only works with iPhones. For Android, choose a Samsung SmartTag or a Tile.

items.name: Anker Soundcore noise-cancelling earbuds
items.alt: Wireless earbuds and their case
items.why: Noise cancelling, a transparency mode and around 10 hours of playtime at an easy gift price.
items.catch: budget noise cancelling softens a commute but won't match $200 earbuds.

items.name: Rechargeable hand warmers
items.alt: Hands in warm knitted mittens
items.why: Reusable warmers that charge by USB. Thoughtful for commuters and anyone who watches outdoor sport.
items.catch: heat lasts a few hours per charge, not all day.

items.name: Wearable sherpa blanket
items.alt: Someone wrapped in a warm blanket
items.why: A hoodie-blanket hybrid with a big front pocket, and one of the most-gifted comfort items every winter.
items.catch: usually one-size and bulky; it's for the sofa, not for going out.

items.name: Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask minis
items.alt: A small jar of balm on a wooden stand
items.why: Mini overnight lip masks in several flavours. A cult favourite at a gift-friendly price.
items.catch: the minis are small, so heavy users will finish them fast.

items.name: Yankee Candle Balsam & Cedar
items.alt: Red candles glowing
items.why: A classic winter scent with a long burn time. A safe pick for a colleague or host.
items.catch: the scent is strong, so skip it for anyone sensitive to fragrance.

bands.label: Kitchen
bands.blurb: The pans and gadgets that see big Black Friday drops.
bands.alt: A frying pan and tomatoes on a blue surface

items.name: Lodge 10.25" cast iron skillet
items.alt: A roast chicken in a cast iron skillet
items.why: Pre-seasoned, goes from hob to oven, and lasts a lifetime. One of the best-value pans you can buy.
items.catch: it's heavy and needs drying and a little oil after washing.

items.name: ThermoWorks ThermoPop 2 thermometer
items.alt: A digital kitchen thermometer
items.why: Reads the temperature in a couple of seconds, with a big display that rotates the right way up. No more guessing if the chicken is done.
items.catch: it's an instant-read probe, so it can't stay in the oven during cooking.

items.name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 (6 qt)
items.alt: A multi-cooker on a kitchen counter
items.why: Pressure cooker, slow cooker and rice cooker in one. Weeknight stews and beans in a fraction of the time.
items.catch: it takes up counter space, and pressure cooking has a short learning curve.

items.name: Lodge 6 qt enameled Dutch oven
items.alt: An orange enameled Dutch oven
items.why: The look and job of a much pricier French oven, for braises, soups and bread.
items.catch: enamel can chip if it's knocked or heated empty on high heat.
items.q: lodge 6 quart enameled cast iron dutch oven

items.name: All-Clad HA1 10" and 12" fry pan set
items.alt: A nonstick frying pan on a wooden table
items.why: Two hard-anodised nonstick pans from a top brand. Tied with its lowest price of 2026 in early November.
items.catch: nonstick wears over time; use wooden or silicone tools and low-to-medium heat.

items.name: Ninja Crispi Pro 6 qt glass air fryer
items.alt: A countertop appliance on a white counter
items.why: Cook, serve, store and reheat in the same glass dish, so there's no basket to scrub. One of this season's hottest kitchen gifts.
items.catch: the glass dish is heavier than a normal air-fryer basket.
items.q: ninja crispi pro 6 qt glass air fryer

bands.label: Desk and tech
bands.blurb: Upgrades for the people who work from home.
bands.alt: A tidy desk with a laptop and mouse

items.name: Logitech MX Master 4 mouse
items.alt: A grey ergonomic wireless mouse
items.why: Logitech's flagship work mouse, with a fast scroll wheel, a thumb wheel and new haptic feedback. Pairs with up to three computers.
items.catch: it's big and right-handed only; small hands may prefer the MX Anywhere.

items.name: Ember Mug 2 (14 oz)
items.alt: A latte next to a keyboard on a desk
items.why: Keeps coffee at the exact temperature they choose in the app, through back-to-back meetings.
items.catch: the battery is short off the coaster, so it works best kept on its charging base. Hand-wash only.

items.name: BenQ ScreenBar monitor light
items.alt: A desk with monitors lit by a monitor light
items.why: A light bar that sits on top of the monitor and lights the desk without glare on the screen. Great for early mornings and late finishes.
items.catch: it needs a monitor; it won't sit on a laptop screen.

items.name: 3-in-1 wireless charging stand
items.alt: A white wireless charging pad on a wooden desk
items.why: Charges a phone, earbuds and a watch in one spot, so the desk stays clear of cables.
items.catch: check it supports their phone and watch brand before you buy.

items.name: Kindle Colorsoft
items.alt: Someone reading an e-reader with a cup of coffee
items.why: A glare-free colour screen for books, comics and highlights. The way to switch off from screens after work.
items.catch: colour is softer than a phone or tablet; for plain novels a regular Kindle is cheaper.

bands.label: Hair tools
bands.blurb: The wish-list stylers, from $49 to the splurge.
bands.alt: A woman styling her hair at home

items.name: Revlon One-Step Volumizer PLUS 2.0
items.alt: A round brush styling long blonde hair
items.why: The best-known hot air brush: dries and adds volume in one pass. A gift that gets used every week.
items.catch: it's heavy for long sessions, and the big barrel suits medium-to-long hair.

items.name: Laifen Swift Special high-speed dryer
items.alt: A black hair dryer
items.why: A light, compact high-speed dryer for a fraction of the premium-brand price.
items.catch: it comes with fewer attachments than premium rivals.

items.name: Shark FlexFusion air styler and straightener
items.alt: A stylist using a blow dryer and round brush
items.why: Dries, curls and straightens with swappable attachments. Reviewed found it at $299 on 6 November, down from its usual $430.
items.catch: still a big spend; if they only dry their hair, a good dryer costs far less.

items.name: Dyson Airwrap i.d. multi-styler
items.alt: Two women with long wavy hair
items.why: The famous one: curls, waves, smooths and dries, with app-guided settings.
items.catch: it's very expensive; the Shark FlexFusion does much of the same for well under half the price.

bands.label: For her
bands.blurb: Little luxuries she won’t buy herself.
bands.alt: A wrapped gift on a cosy blanket

items.name: Owala FreeSip 40 oz tumbler
items.why: A big insulated tumbler with a built-in straw and a side handle, in a lot of colours. It goes everywhere with her.
items.catch: 40 oz won't fit every car cup holder; the 24 oz bottle is the safer size for commuters.
items.alt: An insulated travel tumbler

items.name: Hommey silk eye mask
items.why: A mulberry silk mask that blocks light for naps, flights and lazy weekend mornings.
items.catch: silk needs a gentle hand wash, not the washing machine.
items.alt: A pink eye mask with tea and a candle

items.name: LEGO Botanicals Tiny Plants
items.why: Nine buildable plants in little terracotta-style pots. A calm evening build and a plant she can't kill.
items.catch: it takes a few hours to build, so it suits someone who enjoys a project.
items.alt: Plants in pots built from toy bricks

items.name: Charlotte Tilbury mini beauty set
items.why: Minis of the brand's best-known lip and face products in a gift box. A luxury brand at a gift price.
items.catch: holiday sets change every year, so check what's inside before you buy.
items.alt: A flat lay of makeup and brushes

bands.label: For pet people
bands.blurb: Because the dog is family too.

items.name: KONG Classic dog toy
items.alt: A beagle puppy chewing a toy
items.why: The stuffable rubber toy dog owners swear by. Fill it with treats to keep a dog busy.
items.catch: pick the right size for the dog; too small is a choking risk.

items.name: Cat water fountain
items.alt: A cat drinking water from a bowl
items.why: Many cats prefer moving water to a still bowl. Pick one with an easy-to-clean pump.
items.catch: filters need replacing regularly, a small ongoing cost.

items.name: FURminator deShedding tool
items.alt: A long-coated small dog
items.why: A grooming tool that pulls out loose undercoat before it ends up on the sofa.
items.catch: pick the long- or short-hair version to match the pet's coat.
